item.title: RimWorld Merkmal-Rechner — Eigenschaften & Beziehungen (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: Nutze den RimWorld Merkmal-Rechner, um Eigenschaften und Beziehungen deiner Kolonisten zu erkunden — für die aktuelle 1.6 / Odyssey-Version. Merkmal-Rechner Good traits Bad traits SelectTraitEffectTier Sanguine +10 mood (always). Immune to several negative moodlets. best Industrious Global work speed +30%. best Too Smart Research +40%, learning +70%, but boredom negative moodlets. best Brawler Melee +6 skill, melee attack +30%, but social skills reduced. good Jogger Move speed +25%. good Night Owl +5 mood when awake at night, -5 in the day.
